headline: Peru Congress Approves 266.5 Billion Soles Public Budget for 2027
summary: Peru's Congress approved the Public Sector Budget Law for fiscal year 2027, authorizing 266.51 billion soles for government operations, public investment projects, and social programs.
why: Peru is a leading global producer of copper and silver; the national budget sets the sovereign fiscal deficit and public capital spending priorities.

entities.name: Congreso de la Republica del Peru

impacts.name: Peruvian Sol
impacts.why: Approval of the annual fiscal budget outlines state financing needs and fiscal discipline for the sovereign currency.
